static_traits.name: Lin Kai
static_traits.social_status: Has supportive band members and friends to confide in, but frustration with gardening once strained relations with teammates
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness史；without既往心理治疗或精神科就诊史
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰，逻辑性好，能自我Reflection，配合度高，态度积极

basic_info.main_problem: 我觉得自己永远not会有园艺天赋，因为每次我买吊兰它都会死，这让我感到挫败和without能。
basic_info.core_demands: When I found that these frustrations were affecting my mood and my enjoyment of gardening and other activities, I decided to seek counseling.
growth_experiences: 一年前开始接触园艺，尝试养吊兰，但多次养护失败；每次看到枯死的植物都会引发强烈挫败感与自我not足感。
作为Drummer in an independent band，频繁巡演导致在外时间长、without法规律浇水和维护，这一客观限制加重了植物存活难度。

Repeated failures continuously affect the mood, the interest in and pleasure from gardening has declined, pleasure in other activities has diminished, and when getting along with teammates irritability arises more easily, with relationships affected to a certain extent.
为改善养护结果曾主动研究园艺技巧、查阅资料并use植物护理应用，但仍频繁失败，进一步Reinforcement了without力感与对自我能力的怀疑。

special_situations.event: 看到自己养的吊兰再次枯死
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我连吊兰都养not活，就说明我have not能力、have not园艺天赋
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 加倍研究资料、use植物护理App、严格按教程操作以证明自己能行
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我永远not会有园艺天赋/I am a failure

special_situations.event: 准备开始照料一盆新植物时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果之前失败过，那这次也必然会失败；过去的失败决定not yet来结果
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly checking materials beforehand, carefully adjusting water, fertilizer, and light, and formulating detailed steps to lower the risk of failure
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: without论我怎么做，这次还是会失败

special_situations.event: 巡演在外，without法按时浇水与日常维护
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 我应该即使在频繁巡演中也能把植物养好，否则就证明我without能
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: On returning home, concentrates on remedying and over-caring, trying to control outcomes with more frequent checking
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这都是我的责任；我应该能搞定

special_situations.event: 看到枯死的植物后Low mood，并在与队友排练时感到易怒
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 我现在感到糟糕，就说明我确实not胜任
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 减少谈论园艺话题、把注意力转向情绪发泄（易怒）以短暂缓解without力感
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我感觉很糟，这证明我not适合养植物

positive_force: 具备坚持与主动性：主动查资料、use护理应用，愿意学习与改进
态度积极，能接受建议并愿意设定小目标逐步实践
职业功能稳定（演出not yet受影响），具备基本生活与工作稳定性
拥有支持性的队友与朋友，可在需要时获得情感支持
negative_force: Tour itinerary is frequent, objectively making it difficult to provide stable care (situational constraints are significant)
过度概括与负性预测等思维模式ReinforcementSelf-denial
“应该”式自我要求与个体化归责，忽视外部情境因素
情绪化推理与挫败后易烦躁，影响人际与日常愉悦感

target_behavior.behavior: 在植物养护相关情境下出现的强烈挫败与Self-denial，并在与队友互动中易怒
antecedent: 巡演在外导致without法按时浇水与护理
触景联想到此前多次养护失败
target_behavior.core_reason: 将多次吊兰养护失败归因为自身“without能/have not天赋”，形成过度概括与负性预测；同时巡演带来的客观限制加剧失败经历与without力感。
target_behavior.function: 短期逃避失败感与降低Anxiety（通过Self-denial、易怒发泄或减少谈论），获得暂时的情绪释放与控制感。
target_behavior.consequence: Low mood与兴趣降低，园艺活动受损；与队友Relationship tension；整体日常愉悦感下降。
